params.body:
## What changes for the visitor

Ilse's decision of 17 September 2026 (mail 17:01, third list of the day), task 3.

The always-visible search bar of the website module (the iframe dealers embed) now shows, in this order: **Make, Model, Transmission type, Fuel type** and the **"More filters"** button. **Retail price** and **Mileage** moved into "More filters", with their histogram sliders exactly as before, next to Construction year.

- **Model** follows the chosen make. Without a make it lists every model of the visible stock, "Alle modellen" first (as the bidding list does); with a make only that make's models, both on first render and when the bar refetches after a make change. A chosen model that does not belong to the new make is dropped (existing behaviour, now pinned).
- **Transmission** options come from the vehicles actually in the list (handgeschakeld / automatisch), with their counts; that was already how the list was built.
- Nothing else changes: same filtering, same session contract, same field names (`manufacturer_id`, `model_id`, `transmission_type_id`, `fuel_type_id`, `retail_price` and `mileage` as `min;max`). Deep links (`…/website/<hash>/model_id=12&transmission_type_id=2`) already worked through `convertUrlParams`, so no parameter was added.
- Labels: all four already existed in nl/fr/en/de (`vehicle.manufacturer`, `vehicle.model`, `vehicle.transmission_type`, `vehicle.fuel_type`, `ui.all_models`); no new translation keys.

Responsive: below 560px container width only the button (unchanged); from 560 Make + Model; from 720 (an iframe of roughly 770px) all four. The bar's tier-2 breakpoint came down from 920 because four selects need less room than two sliders did.

## Code

- `WebsiteController::availableWebsiteModels()` builds the model list for both the page and the `getAvailableModels` endpoint (make filter only when a make is given).
- `website/search.blade.php`: the bar; `website/tabs/general.blade.php`: price and km sliders in the panel; the model refetch keeps "Alle modellen" and re-applies the facet counts.
- `public/css/website-iframe.css` (the iframe's own stylesheet; `refresh.css` untouched): breakpoint and comments.
- Rule **R S2-5.23** in `12-s2-eigen-wagenpark-publiceren.md`, source `klant:beslissingen#lijsten-2026-09-17`; `bin/rules-sources` prints "Geen problemen".
- `tests/Feature/WebsiteFilterBarTest.php` (6 tests, `@rule S2-5.23`): the order and placement, the model list with and without a make (page and endpoint), transmission options from the list, model/transmission/price/mileage still narrow the list, make change drops a foreign model. Three of the six fail against `main`.

## Screenshots

Before/after at 1440, 800 and 390, closed and with "More filters" open, in `.playwright-mcp/iframe-filters/` of the worktree (listed in the report).
params.title: Website module: filter bar shows make, model, transmission and fuel; price and km behind "More filters"
